description: Test suite for quic_utils functions in the quiche/quic/core directory, including address change detection, hash functions, connection ID generation, and packet header identification.

classes.name: QuicUtilsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for quic_utils tests.

methods.name: DetermineAddressChangeType
methods.description: Determines the type of address change between two socket addresses.

methods.name: IncrementalHashReference
methods.description: Computes a hash of data using a custom incremental hash algorithm.

methods.name: ReferenceTest
methods.description: Test comparing custom hash with FNV1a hash.

methods.name: IsUnackable
methods.description: Checks if a packet state is unackable.

methods.name: RetransmissionTypeToPacketState
methods.description: Converts a transmission type to a packet state.

methods.name: IsIetfPacketHeader
methods.description: Checks if a packet header byte indicates an IETF QUIC packet.

methods.name: CreateZeroConnectionId
methods.description: Creates a zero-length connection ID for a specific version.

methods.name: GenerateStatelessResetToken
methods.description: Generates a stateless reset token from a connection ID.

methods.name: AreStatelessResetTokensEqual
methods.description: Checks equality of two stateless reset tokens.

methods.name: EcnCodepointToString
methods.description: Converts an ECN codepoint enum to string.
